agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL OF MONTEREY PARK
  CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

  NOTICE OF CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL COMMUNITY MEETING

  As a quorum of the City Council may be present for the event, this special meeting
  notice is being issued for the purpose of the Brown Act pursuant to Government
  Code Section 54956. 1 Members of the City Council present will not formally
  convene as a body, nor will they take any formal action at the event.

  Community Conversations

  City Hall Community Room 102
  320 W. Newmark Ave., Monterey Park 91754

  Saturday
  May 2, 2026
  10:00 a.m. – 11:00 a.m.

  I.  Welcome

  II.  Community members are invited for casual conversations and to learn more
  about City programs and services with Monterey Park Council Members and
  staff.

  III.  Adjournment

1 This agenda is being posted in an abundance of caution in accordance with ___ Ops.Cal.Atty.Gen. ___

(April 18, 2024) [Opn. No. 23-102 at 2024 WL 1812958].
minutes_text:
74-187

  Minutes
  Monterey Park City Council
  Special Community Meeting
  May 2, 2026

The City Council of the City of Monterey Park held a Special Community Meeting of the
Council at the City Hall Community Room 102 located at 320 W. Newmark Ave.,
Monterey Park, CA, 91754 on Saturday May 2, 2026 at 10:00 a.m.

1.  Call to Order
  Assistant City Manager Diana Garcia called the meeting to order at 10:00 a.m.

2.  Roll Call

  Assistant City Manager Garcia called the roll:

  Council Members Present: Thomas Wong
  Council Members Absent: Henry Lo, Vinh Ngo, Jose Sanchez, Elizabeth Yang

  Also Present:
  None

  Community Conversations

  I. Welcome

  II. Community members are invited for casual conversations and to learn more
  about City programs and services with Monterey Park Council Members and
  staff.

  III. Adjournment

  Due to a lack of quorum, the meeting was adjourned at 10:15 a.m. by Assistant
  City Manager Garcia.

  _________________
  Maychelle Yee
  City Clerk

  Mission Statement
The mission of the City of Monterey Park is to provide excellent service, foster growth
  and opportunity, and create a joyous

  and collaborative environment.
